stages.name: Success Planning
stages.objective: Define customer success outcomes and alignment with customer goals
stages.input: Customer contract, product roadmap, customer's business objectives
stages.output: Customer success plan documenting goals and outcomes
stages.activities: Discovery meeting with customer, document business goals, identify success criteria, map to product capabilities, define success metrics
stages.tools: Success planning templates, customer data platforms, CRM
stages.successMetric: Success plan documented and approved by customer
stages.decisionPoints: Success criteria clear? Aligned to business outcomes? Realistic timeline?
stages.qualityGate: Success plan approved, metrics agreed, customer aligned

stages.name: Stakeholder Mapping
stages.objective: Identify all customer stakeholders and their roles
stages.input: Customer org chart, success plan, buying committee
stages.output: Stakeholder map with roles, influence, support needs
stages.activities: Identify executive sponsor, identify end users, identify technical stakeholders, map influence/power, identify objection handlers
stages.successMetric: Stakeholder map with 5+ stakeholders identified and profiled
stages.decisionPoints: Right stakeholders identified? Executive support secured? Influencers identified?
stages.qualityGate: Stakeholder map complete, executive sponsor identified, communication plan drafted

stages.name: Timeline & Milestones
stages.objective: Create realistic onboarding timeline with key milestones
stages.input: Customer context, product setup complexity, resource availability
stages.output: Detailed onboarding timeline with milestones (30/60/90 day plan)
stages.activities: Map onboarding phases, identify key milestones, identify critical path, plan resource allocation, build buffer time
stages.successMetric: Timeline with all milestones and dependencies mapped
stages.decisionPoints: Timeline realistic? Dependencies clear? Customer constraints understood?
stages.qualityGate: Timeline approved by customer and internal team

stages.name: Training & Enablement Plan
stages.objective: Design training curriculum specific to customer's needs and users
stages.input: Customer user profiles, product capabilities, success plan
stages.output: Training curriculum with delivery method and schedule
stages.activities: Assess user skill levels, design role-specific training paths, create training materials, plan delivery method (live/video/docs), schedule training sessions
stages.successMetric: Training curriculum documented with user groups and schedules
stages.decisionPoints: Right training depth? Appropriate delivery method? Enough time allocated?
stages.qualityGate: Training plan approved, materials ready, delivery scheduled

stages.name: Success Metrics Definition
stages.objective: Quantify success with measurable outcomes and tracking plan
stages.input: Success plan, customer goals, product metrics available
stages.output: Dashboard with KPIs, success metrics, and tracking approach
stages.activities: Map customer goals to product metrics, identify leading/lagging indicators, set success thresholds, design tracking/reporting, identify data sources
stages.tools: Analytics platforms, dashboard tools, data warehouse
stages.successMetric: Success dashboard designed with 3-5 key metrics and tracking plan
stages.decisionPoints: Metrics aligned to business goals? Data available? Achievable targets?
stages.qualityGate: Success metrics agreed, dashboard built, reporting cadence set

stages.name: Communication & Engagement Plan
stages.objective: Design communication cadence and engagement model with customer
stages.input: Stakeholder map, timeline, success plan
stages.output: Communication plan with cadence, channels, owners
stages.activities: Define communication cadence (weekly/bi-weekly/monthly), identify channels per stakeholder, assign owners, plan check-in agendas, plan escalation path
stages.successMetric: Communication plan with cadence, channels, and owners documented
stages.decisionPoints: Right frequency? Stakeholder preferences understood? Engagement ownership clear?
stages.qualityGate: Communication plan approved by customer, calendar locked

stages.name: Kickoff Preparation
stages.objective: Prepare materials and team for customer kickoff
stages.input: All prior stages, team assignments, customer context
stages.output: Kickoff meeting materials and prepared team
stages.activities: Prepare kickoff presentation, assign team roles, brief internal team, prepare customer materials, confirm attendees, test technology
stages.tools: Presentation tools, meeting software, communication systems
stages.roles: CSM (lead), Executive sponsor (input), Technical team (setup), Product (demo)
stages.successMetric: Kickoff materials ready, team briefed, customer confirmed
stages.decisionPoints: Team ready? Materials clear? Customer expectations set? Technology working?
stages.qualityGate: Kickoff scheduled, materials approved, team prepared, customer confirmed

stages.name: Setup & Configuration
stages.objective: Configure product instance for customer's specific needs
stages.input: Success plan, customer requirements, integration needs
stages.output: Configured product instance ready for training
stages.activities: Provision account/workspace, configure settings per customer needs, set up custom fields, configure workflows, set up integrations, test configuration
stages.tools: Product admin console, integration platform, CRM, data platforms
stages.roles: Onboarding specialist (execution), Product experts (complex configs), Customer (requirements)
stages.successMetric: Product configured and tested, ready for user training
stages.decisionPoints: Configuration accurate? All integrations working? User permissions set correctly?
stages.qualityGate: Configuration complete and tested, customer approved

stages.name: User Provisioning
stages.objective: Create user accounts and set up access for all customer users
stages.input: Stakeholder map, user profiles, access requirements
stages.output: All users provisioned with correct permissions and access
stages.activities: Create user accounts per user list, assign role-based permissions, configure authentication/SSO if needed, test access, send credential information
stages.tools: User management systems, SSO platforms, identity management
stages.roles: Onboarding tech (execution), IT support (if SSO), Customer IT (requirements)
stages.successMetric: All users provisioned and able to log in
stages.decisionPoints: Permissions correct per role? SSO configured? Access tested?
stages.qualityGate: All users active, permissions verified, login confirmed

stages.name: Technical Integration
stages.objective: Connect product to customer's existing systems and workflows
stages.input: Integration requirements, existing system details, API documentation
stages.output: Active integrations with all required systems
stages.activities: Map integration requirements, configure API connections, build/configure middleware if needed, test data flows, monitor for issues
stages.tools: Integration platforms, APIs, middleware solutions, monitoring tools
stages.roles: Integration specialist (setup), Technical team (execution), Customer IT (requirements)
stages.successMetric: All planned integrations live and syncing
stages.decisionPoints: Data flows working correctly? No data loss? Monitoring in place? Error handling configured?
stages.qualityGate: Integrations tested and stable, monitoring active

stages.name: Training Delivery
stages.objective: Execute training curriculum with all user groups
stages.input: Training curriculum, user groups, materials
stages.output: Trained users ready to use product
stages.activities: Conduct live training sessions, answer questions, provide hands-on practice, capture attendance, assess understanding, provide recordings
stages.tools: Training platform, video conferencing, recording tools
stages.roles: Training specialist (delivery), Product expert (complex topics), CSM (coordination)
stages.successMetric: Training sessions delivered, 80%+ attendance, participants rated ready
stages.decisionPoints: Training effective? Users asking right questions? Pace appropriate? Hands-on practice sufficient?
stages.qualityGate: All training sessions completed, attendance tracked, feedback positive

stages.name: Adoption Monitoring
stages.objective: Track user adoption and identify gaps during early usage
stages.input: Success metrics, product usage data, training completed
stages.output: Adoption report with usage patterns and identified blockers
stages.activities: Monitor daily/weekly usage, identify inactive users, identify feature adoption gaps, reach out to struggling users, provide targeted help
stages.tools: Product analytics, usage dashboards, communication tools
stages.successMetric: Adoption metrics tracked, 60%+ active users, key features adopted by 40%+
stages.decisionPoints: Adoption on track? Blockers identified? Training gaps? Engagement needed?
stages.qualityGate: Adoption baseline established, intervention plan for underperformers

stages.name: Support & Troubleshooting
stages.objective: Provide rapid support for issues encountered during onboarding
stages.input: Customer questions, technical issues, usage blockers
stages.output: Resolved issues, engaged support team, updated documentation
stages.activities: Triage support requests, resolve common issues quickly, escalate complex issues, document solutions, update FAQs, track resolution time
stages.tools: Support ticketing, knowledge base, live chat, communication
stages.successMetric: Support tickets resolved <24hrs, 90%+ first-contact resolution
stages.decisionPoints: Resolution time acceptable? Escalation paths working? Pattern identification?
stages.qualityGate: Support SLA met, issue resolution tracked, common issues documented

stages.name: Adoption Acceleration
stages.objective: Drive feature adoption and increase usage to success metrics
stages.input: Adoption monitoring data, usage gaps, user feedback
stages.output: Adoption acceleration plan with targeted interventions
stages.activities: Identify power users for peer learning, conduct feature adoption campaigns, provide use-case specific training, celebrate milestones, remove friction points
stages.tools: Adoption campaigns, user communication, in-app messaging
stages.successMetric: Feature adoption increasing, usage trending toward success metrics
stages.decisionPoints: Adoption accelerating? Right features prioritized? User engagement increasing?
stages.qualityGate: Adoption plan working, metrics trending up, engagement consistent

stages.name: Baseline Establishment
stages.objective: Establish customer's current state before product use
stages.input: Customer success plan, metrics defined, customer's current operations
stages.output: Documented baseline for comparison
stages.activities: Understand current process/metrics, quantify current state, identify measurement methodology, establish historical data, document assumptions
stages.successMetric: Baseline documented with current state and methodology
stages.decisionPoints: Baseline clear? Measurement method agreed? Historical data available?
stages.qualityGate: Baseline approved by customer, documented in success plan

stages.name: Quick Win Identification
stages.objective: Identify early wins to build momentum and demonstrate value
stages.input: Success metrics, customer use case, product capabilities
stages.output: 2-3 identified quick wins with implementation plan
stages.activities: Analyze success metrics for highest-impact targets, identify shortest-time-to-value initiatives, design quick win implementation, plan communication
stages.successMetric: 2-3 quick wins identified and prioritized
stages.decisionPoints: Quick wins realistic? High-impact? Visible to customer? Communication planned?
stages.qualityGate: Quick wins approved by customer, implementation plan started

stages.name: Value Tracking Setup
stages.objective: Set up system to track and demonstrate value realization
stages.input: Success metrics, baseline, data sources
stages.output: Dashboard/report showing value tracking
stages.activities: Connect data sources, configure metric calculations, set up automated reporting, establish reporting cadence, plan communication approach
stages.successMetric: Value dashboard live and auto-updating
stages.decisionPoints: Data sources accurate? Calculations correct? Reporting frequency right? Accessible to customer?
stages.qualityGate: Dashboard deployed, first report generated, customer trained

stages.name: Milestone Planning
stages.objective: Plan value-focused milestones through engagement lifecycle
stages.input: Success plan, timeline, value realization targets
stages.output: Milestone calendar with targets and celebration plan
stages.activities: Map major milestones (30/60/90 days, 6mo, 1yr), assign targets for each, plan communications, plan celebrations/reviews, track progress
stages.successMetric: Milestone calendar with targets and celebration plan documented
stages.decisionPoints: Milestones motivating? Targets achievable? Celebration plan resonant?
stages.qualityGate: Milestones agreed, targets locked, communication plan ready

stages.name: Business Review Planning
stages.objective: Plan cadence and structure for business value reviews
stages.input: Milestones, success metrics, stakeholder needs
stages.output: Business review calendar with agenda templates
stages.activities: Define review frequency (30/60/90 days, quarterly), design agenda structure, identify attendees, plan communication, create presentation templates
stages.successMetric: Business review calendar and templates ready
stages.decisionPoints: Review frequency right? Stakeholders identified? Agenda structure clear? Presentation templates useful?
stages.qualityGate: Business review schedule locked, templates created, first review scheduled

stages.name: ROI Documentation
stages.objective: Document and communicate ROI to customer stakeholders
stages.input: Value realization data, cost information, customer context
stages.output: ROI report with financial and business impact
stages.activities: Calculate financial ROI, document non-financial benefits, create executive summary, prepare presentation, identify cost avoidance, project forward
stages.tools: ROI calculators, presentation tools, financial models
stages.successMetric: ROI documentation complete with financial and operational impact
stages.decisionPoints: ROI credible? Methodology transparent? Communicated effectively?
stages.qualityGate: ROI approved by customer, ready for stakeholder communication

stages.name: Curriculum Design
stages.objective: Design comprehensive training program covering all product areas
stages.input: Product features, customer use cases, skill levels needed
stages.output: Complete training curriculum with modules and progression
stages.activities: Define learning objectives per module, create module structure, design learning paths, identify prerequisite knowledge, scope content depth
stages.tools: Instructional design tools, learning management systems
stages.successMetric: Curriculum designed with 5-10 modules covering key use cases
stages.decisionPoints: Comprehensive? Appropriately scoped? Role-based paths clear?
stages.qualityGate: Curriculum reviewed by product/customer, modules defined

stages.name: Role-Based Learning Paths
stages.objective: Create customized learning paths for different user roles
stages.input: User personas, job functions, product capabilities
stages.output: Learning paths mapped to roles with sequencing
stages.activities: Analyze user roles, design path for each role, identify prerequisite modules, sequence modules, estimate completion time
stages.successMetric: Learning paths defined for 4-6 key user roles
stages.decisionPoints: Paths comprehensive? Prerequisites clear? Time realistic?
stages.qualityGate: Role-based paths defined and sequenced

stages.name: Training Content Development
stages.objective: Create high-quality training materials in multiple formats
stages.input: Curriculum, learning paths, product documentation
stages.output: Complete training materials (video, docs, interactive)
stages.activities: Create video modules, write training documentation, develop practice scenarios, design interactive exercises, create reference guides
stages.tools: Video production, documentation tools, interactive platforms
stages.roles: Training specialist (project), Subject matter experts (content), Video producer (production)
stages.successMetric: Training materials completed for all curriculum modules
stages.decisionPoints: Content quality high? Engaging? Comprehensive? Accessible?
stages.qualityGate: Materials reviewed and approved by product/SMEs

stages.name: Delivery Planning
stages.objective: Plan training delivery schedule and logistics
stages.input: Training materials, customer organization, resource availability
stages.output: Training delivery calendar with logistics
stages.activities: Schedule training sessions, identify trainer assignments, plan registration process, arrange technology/facilities, prepare trainer materials
stages.tools: Calendar management, event planning, trainer prep templates
stages.successMetric: Training schedule published with all logistics planned
stages.decisionPoints: Scheduling accessible to customer? Trainer capacity? Technology confirmed?
stages.qualityGate: Training calendar locked, trainers prepared, logistics confirmed

stages.name: Training Delivery
stages.objective: Conduct live training sessions with tracking and support
stages.input: Training materials, scheduled sessions, registered users
stages.output: Trained participants with tracked completion
stages.activities: Deliver live training, answer questions, manage Q&A, track attendance, provide recordings, send follow-up materials
stages.tools: Video conferencing, recording, learning management systems
stages.successMetric: All training sessions delivered, 80%+ attendance
stages.decisionPoints: Engagement level? Question quality? Pace appropriate? Recording quality?
stages.qualityGate: Sessions delivered, attendance tracked, recordings available

stages.name: Assessment & Certification
stages.objective: Assess user competency and issue certifications
stages.input: Training completion, assessment requirements, skill levels
stages.output: Certifications issued, competency documented
stages.activities: Design assessment approach (quiz/practical/both), administer assessments, score results, issue certificates, track by user role
stages.successMetric: 70%+ of users complete and pass assessments
stages.decisionPoints: Assessment level appropriate? Passing threshold clear? Certificates valuable?
stages.qualityGate: Assessment process complete, certifications issued, records maintained

stages.name: Ongoing Education & Updates
stages.objective: Maintain training as product evolves and users develop
stages.input: Product updates, user feedback, new use cases
stages.output: Updated curriculum and continued learning opportunities
stages.activities: Monitor product changes, update relevant modules, create refresher content, plan advanced training, identify super users for peer learning
stages.roles: Training specialist (updates), Product team (change awareness), Super users (peer learning)
stages.successMetric: Curriculum updated quarterly, 40%+ of users engage in ongoing learning
stages.decisionPoints: Updates timely? Advanced training valuable? Peer learning scalable?
stages.qualityGate: Update process established, advanced curriculum ready

stages.name: Health Indicator Selection
stages.objective: Define metrics that predict customer health and renewal likelihood
stages.input: Success metrics, historical data, customer feedback, product usage
stages.output: Health score model with leading and lagging indicators
stages.activities: Define health dimensions (adoption, engagement, value realization, sentiment), identify predictive metrics, determine weighting, establish health score calculation
stages.successMetric: Health score model defined with 5-10 indicators
stages.decisionPoints: Indicators predictive? Data available? Model accurate? Actionable?
stages.qualityGate: Health score model validated, baseline established for all customers

stages.name: Real-Time Monitoring
stages.objective: Monitor customer health continuously in real-time
stages.input: Health score model, customer data, product usage
stages.output: Health dashboard with current status for all customers
stages.activities: Integrate data sources, automate health calculations, create dashboards, set up alerts for red flags, establish monitoring rhythm
stages.successMetric: Health dashboard live, updating daily, alerts active
stages.decisionPoints: Data feeds reliable? Calculations accurate? Alerts actionable? Visibility complete?
stages.qualityGate: Monitoring system live, first alerts reviewed

stages.name: Risk Assessment
stages.objective: Identify at-risk customers and assess churn probability
stages.input: Health scores, customer data, historical churn patterns
stages.output: At-risk customer list with churn probability and risk factors
stages.activities: Identify customers with low health scores, assess multiple risk factors, rate churn probability, identify root causes, prioritize by revenue risk
stages.successMetric: At-risk customers identified with risk factors and probability
stages.decisionPoints: Risk factors clear? Probability accurate? Actionable interventions identified?
stages.qualityGate: At-risk list reviewed, intervention plans ready

stages.name: Intervention Planning
stages.objective: Plan targeted interventions for at-risk customers
stages.input: At-risk customer list, risk factors, customer context
stages.output: Intervention playbook with actions per risk type
stages.activities: Analyze root causes for each at-risk customer, design targeted interventions, assign ownership, plan escalation path, track intervention effectiveness
stages.successMetric: Intervention plan for each at-risk customer
stages.decisionPoints: Interventions targeted to root cause? Ownership clear? Escalation appropriate?
stages.qualityGate: Intervention plans documented, assigned, tracking started

stages.name: Proactive Engagement
stages.objective: Execute proactive outreach to maintain and improve customer health
stages.input: Health scores, customer preferences, use case opportunities
stages.output: Engagement activities scheduled and tracked
stages.activities: Schedule proactive check-ins, identify expansion opportunities, provide training on underused features, introduce new features, celebrate milestones
stages.successMetric: Proactive outreach to 50%+ of customers, engagement rates increasing
stages.decisionPoints: Outreach well-timed? Valuable to customer? Adoption increasing?
stages.qualityGate: Proactive engagement plan executed, metrics improving

stages.name: Renewal Readiness Assessment
stages.objective: Assess readiness for renewal conversations 90 days before expiration
stages.input: Renewal date, health score, value realization, expansion potential
stages.output: Renewal readiness report with strategy
stages.activities: Assess value delivery and ROI achievement, gather customer testimonials, identify expansion opportunities, prepare renewal economics, plan renewal conversation
stages.successMetric: Renewal strategy documented for each customer
stages.decisionPoints: ROI clear? Expansion valuable? Negotiation strategy right? Executive alignment?
stages.qualityGate: Renewal conversations started 90+ days before expiration

stages.name: Feature Selection & Prioritization
stages.objective: Identify features to drive adoption based on business impact
stages.input: Feature roadmap, customer usage data, business objectives
stages.output: Prioritized feature list with adoption target
stages.activities: Identify underadopted features, assess business impact of adoption, identify target user segments, set adoption targets, prioritize features
stages.roles: Product (feature expertise), Analytics (adoption data), CSM (customer context)
stages.successMetric: Prioritized feature list with adoption targets
stages.decisionPoints: Features high-impact? Adoption realistic? User interest?
stages.qualityGate: Features prioritized, adoption targets set, campaign approved

stages.name: User Segmentation
stages.objective: Segment users by adoption readiness and learning style
stages.input: User profiles, adoption history, learning preferences
stages.output: User segments with tailored campaign approaches
stages.activities: Segment by adoption readiness (early adopters/mainstream/laggards), segment by learning style, segment by department/use case, identify champions per segment
stages.successMetric: User segments defined with 80%+ of users classified
stages.decisionPoints: Segments meaningful? Tailored approaches different? Champions identified?
stages.qualityGate: Segments validated, champion identification complete

stages.name: Campaign Design
stages.objective: Design targeted adoption campaign for each user segment
stages.input: Feature details, user segments, adoption barriers
stages.output: Campaign strategy with messaging, content, timeline
stages.activities: Design segment-specific messaging, create educational content, design in-app prompts, plan email outreach, plan webinars, create quick-start guides
stages.tools: Content creation, campaign templates, in-app messaging
stages.successMetric: Campaign strategy documented for each segment
stages.decisionPoints: Messaging resonant? Content comprehensive? Timeline realistic? Multi-channel?
stages.qualityGate: Campaign strategy approved, content ready, messaging tested

stages.name: Launch & Promotion
stages.objective: Launch adoption campaign and drive awareness
stages.input: Campaign strategy, content, user segments, launch plan
stages.output: Campaign live with promotional activities
stages.activities: Deploy in-app messaging, send campaign emails, host webinars, share content via channels, activate champions for peer promotion
stages.tools: Email platform, in-app messaging, webinar tools, communication systems
stages.successMetric: Campaign launched, 60%+ of target users exposed
stages.decisionPoints: Launch smooth? Message clarity? Channel mix effective? Champion engagement?
stages.qualityGate: Campaign fully launched, tracking active, first week metrics reviewed

stages.name: Adoption Tracking & Support
stages.objective: Monitor adoption progress and provide targeted support
stages.input: Campaign live, adoption data, user feedback
stages.output: Adoption metrics and support insights
stages.activities: Track daily adoption, identify struggling users, provide targeted help, respond to questions, celebrate early adopters, refine messaging based on feedback
stages.tools: Analytics dashboards, support chat, feedback collection
stages.successMetric: Adoption metrics showing 30%+ of target segment using feature
stages.decisionPoints: Adoption trending up? Early adopters engaged? Support needs identified?
stages.qualityGate: Adoption tracking active, support processes working

stages.name: Analysis & Reporting
stages.objective: Analyze campaign effectiveness and identify learning
stages.input: Adoption metrics, campaign data, user feedback
stages.output: Campaign analysis report with ROI and learning
stages.activities: Calculate adoption rate and ROI, analyze by segment, identify barriers/accelerators, gather qualitative feedback, document learning
stages.successMetric: Campaign analysis completed with ROI calculated
stages.decisionPoints: ROI clear? Learning captured? Barriers understood? Next iteration clear?
stages.qualityGate: Analysis approved, learning documented, next campaign ready

stages.name: Baseline Usage Definition
stages.objective: Establish expected usage patterns by user type and company size
stages.input: Product telemetry, customer data, industry benchmarks
stages.output: Usage baseline by customer segment
stages.activities: Define usage metrics (logins, features used, actions per session), establish benchmarks by segment, identify normal variation, document baseline methodology
stages.successMetric: Usage baseline defined for 3-5 customer segments
stages.decisionPoints: Metrics meaningful? Benchmarks accurate? Variation understood?
stages.qualityGate: Usage baseline approved, documented

stages.name: Real-Time Monitoring
stages.objective: Set up continuous monitoring of customer usage
stages.input: Usage baseline, customer data, telemetry system
stages.output: Live usage dashboard by customer
stages.activities: Integrate customer usage data, create usage dashboards, set up automated alerts, establish monitoring cadence, track usage trends
stages.successMetric: Usage dashboard live with real-time data for all customers
stages.decisionPoints: Data accurate? Dashboard useful? Alert timing right? Accessible to team?
stages.qualityGate: Monitoring system live, baseline comparison visible

stages.name: Alert Configuration
stages.objective: Set up alerts for usage patterns indicating risk or opportunity
stages.input: Usage baseline, churn risk factors, expansion signals
stages.output: Alert system configured with thresholds
stages.activities: Define alert triggers (sudden drop-off, feature non-adoption, increasing usage), set thresholds, assign owners, test alerts, plan response workflow
stages.successMetric: Alert system configured with 5-10 meaningful triggers
stages.decisionPoints: Triggers predictive? Alert volume manageable? Response process clear?
stages.qualityGate: Alerts tested, response processes defined, team trained

stages.name: Proactive Outreach
stages.objective: Reach out proactively based on usage signals
stages.input: Alert triggers, customer context, usage data
stages.output: Proactive outreach activities logged and tracked
stages.activities: Contact at-risk customers about usage decline, reach out with feature tips based on low adoption, celebrate usage milestones, provide targeted training
stages.successMetric: 80%+ of alert triggers result in proactive outreach
stages.decisionPoints: Outreach well-timed? Valuable to customer? Response positive?
stages.qualityGate: Proactive outreach process working, engagement rates positive

stages.name: Learning Platform Evaluation & Selection
stages.objective: Evaluate and select learning management system (LMS) for customer education
stages.input: Learning requirements, budget, integration needs, user volume
stages.output: Selected LMS platform with implementation plan
stages.activities: Define LMS requirements, evaluate platforms (Thought Industries, Docebo, Lessonly), assess integration capabilities, pilot with team, negotiate contracts
stages.successMetric: LMS selected, contract signed, implementation roadmap ready
stages.decisionPoints: Right feature set? Scalable? Integration feasible? Cost acceptable?
stages.qualityGate: Platform selected and contracted, vendor kickoff scheduled

stages.name: Learning & Content Strategy
stages.objective: Define what to teach and learning paths
stages.input: Customer use cases, skill levels, product roadmap
stages.output: Learning strategy with curriculum roadmap
stages.activities: Map learning objectives, design learning paths by role, define curriculum scope, plan content types, identify prerequisite learning
stages.successMetric: Learning strategy documented with curriculum roadmap
stages.decisionPoints: Comprehensive? Role-based paths? Content appropriate depth?
stages.qualityGate: Learning strategy approved, curriculum plan finalized

stages.name: Content Production Pipeline
stages.objective: Build content production process for continuous curriculum development
stages.input: Curriculum plan, content types, production team
stages.output: Content production workflow and templates
stages.activities: Design content production workflow, create content templates, assign producers, establish review process, plan technology stack
stages.successMetric: Production pipeline live with first content in progress
stages.decisionPoints: Workflow efficient? Quality standards clear? Resources adequate?
stages.qualityGate: Production process established, content pipeline active

stages.name: Content Development & Launch
stages.objective: Develop and launch initial content library
stages.input: Curriculum plan, content templates, production pipeline
stages.output: Live content library on LMS with core courses
stages.activities: Produce video modules, write documentation, create interactive exercises, design assessments, upload to LMS, test access
stages.successMetric: 10-15 core courses live on LMS
stages.decisionPoints: Content quality high? Engaging? Technically sound? User experience smooth?
stages.qualityGate: Content library live, user testing positive

stages.name: Learner Enrollment & Progress Tracking
stages.objective: Manage learner enrollments and track progress
stages.input: User list, learning paths, LMS platform
stages.output: Enrollment system with progress tracking dashboard
stages.activities: Configure enrollment rules by role, set up progress tracking, create learner dashboards, establish completion tracking, integrate with CRM
stages.successMetric: All users enrolled in appropriate paths, progress tracked
stages.decisionPoints: Enrollment automated? Progress visible? Mobile accessible?
stages.qualityGate: Enrollment complete, progress dashboard live

stages.name: Assessment & Certification
stages.objective: Assess learner competency and issue certifications
stages.input: Assessment requirements, competency standards
stages.output: Assessment system with certification issuance
stages.activities: Design assessments (quizzes/practical/projects), set passing scores, create certification criteria, automate certificate generation, track completions
stages.successMetric: Assessment system live, first certifications issued
stages.decisionPoints: Assessments aligned to learning? Certification valuable? Passing standards fair?
stages.qualityGate: Assessment system tested, certificates being issued

stages.name: Usage Analytics & Continuous Improvement
stages.objective: Monitor platform usage and continuously improve content
stages.input: Usage data, learner feedback, completion metrics
stages.output: Analytics dashboard with improvement roadmap
stages.activities: Track completion rates by course, identify struggling courses, gather learner feedback, analyze time-to-completion, plan content updates
stages.successMetric: Usage analytics live, quarterly improvement cycles active
stages.decisionPoints: Insights actionable? Improvements resonating? Adoption increasing?
stages.qualityGate: Analytics active, continuous improvement cycle established

stages.name: Community Strategy & Goals
stages.objective: Define community objectives and success metrics
stages.input: Customer engagement goals, business objectives, customer feedback
stages.output: Community strategy with goals and success metrics
stages.activities: Define community purpose and value proposition, set engagement targets, identify key discussions, define moderation approach, plan evolution
stages.successMetric: Community strategy documented with clear goals
stages.decisionPoints: Purpose compelling? Targets realistic? Moderation plan clear?
stages.qualityGate: Strategy approved, success metrics defined

stages.name: Community Platform Setup
stages.objective: Select and configure community platform
stages.input: Community strategy, platform requirements, budget
stages.output: Live community platform ready for members
stages.activities: Evaluate platforms (Mighty Networks, Slack communities, Discord), configure platform structure, set up channels/groups, configure user roles, design user experience
stages.successMetric: Platform live with structure designed and tested
stages.decisionPoints: Platform chosen fits strategy? Configuration intuitive? Scalable?
stages.qualityGate: Platform live, team trained, ready for member launch

stages.name: Moderator & Community Manager Preparation
stages.objective: Train moderators and community managers
stages.input: Moderation guidelines, platform training, community strategy
stages.output: Prepared moderation team ready to support community
stages.activities: Hire/assign community managers, train on platform, establish moderation guidelines, create response templates, plan escalation paths
stages.successMetric: Moderation team trained and equipped
stages.decisionPoints: Team capacity adequate? Guidelines clear? Response templates helpful?
stages.qualityGate: Moderators trained, ready to launch

stages.name: Initial Member Recruitment
stages.objective: Recruit founding members and build critical mass
stages.input: Customer list, invitation strategy, community value prop
stages.output: Initial member base of 50-100+ engaged members
stages.activities: Invite high-engagement customers, send invitation with value prop, onboard in waves, encourage peer invites, monitor early adoption
stages.successMetric: 50-100 members joined, activity visible
stages.decisionPoints: Right member mix? Value evident? Early adoption positive?
stages.qualityGate: Founding members active, momentum building

stages.name: Content & Discussion Kickoff
stages.objective: Seed community with valuable initial content and discussions
stages.input: Content strategy, moderators trained, early members
stages.output: Active discussions and valued content flowing
stages.activities: Post initial content pieces, ask thoughtful questions to start discussions, highlight early contributions, encourage peer-to-peer answers, recognize early contributors
stages.successMetric: Active discussions daily, peer engagement visible
stages.decisionPoints: Participation encouraged? Quality high? Conversations authentic?
stages.qualityGate: Community showing signs of natural engagement

stages.name: Recognition & Gamification
stages.objective: Recognize contributions and drive ongoing engagement
stages.input: Engagement data, member contributions, recognition budget
stages.output: Recognition program with incentives
stages.activities: Create badges for contributions, recognize top contributors monthly, highlight member stories, create leaderboards, plan rewards/incentives
stages.successMetric: Recognition program active, engagement increasing
stages.decisionPoints: Recognition meaningful? Gamification motivating? Rewards valuable?
stages.qualityGate: Recognition program running, members responding

stages.name: Analytics & Evolution
stages.objective: Measure community health and plan evolution
stages.input: Engagement metrics, member feedback, community data
stages.output: Community analytics dashboard with growth plan
stages.activities: Track member growth, monitor engagement patterns, analyze top discussions, gather feedback, plan expansion, identify power users
stages.successMetric: Analytics dashboard live, growth trajectory positive
stages.decisionPoints: Growth metrics on track? Member satisfaction high? New initiatives clear?
stages.qualityGate: Analytics active, evolution roadmap created

stages.name: At-Risk Customer Identification
stages.objective: Identify customers at highest risk of churn
stages.input: Health scores, usage data, engagement metrics
stages.output: At-risk customer list with churn probability
stages.activities: Identify customers with declining health scores, analyze leading churn indicators, segment by risk level, assess revenue impact, prioritize by strategic value
stages.tools: Health monitoring dashboards, churn prediction models
stages.successMetric: At-risk customers identified with churn probability >50%
stages.decisionPoints: Churn prediction accurate? Risk factors understood? Intervention options clear?
stages.qualityGate: At-risk list approved, intervention plan started

stages.name: Root Cause Analysis
stages.objective: Understand why customer is at risk
stages.input: At-risk customer list, customer interactions, usage data
stages.output: Root cause analysis per customer with intervention recommendations
stages.activities: Conduct customer interviews, analyze usage patterns, review customer issues, identify unmet needs, document satisfaction gaps
stages.successMetric: Root cause documented for 90%+ of at-risk customers
stages.decisionPoints: Root cause clear? Multiple factors or single issue? Fixable or customer changing?
stages.qualityGate: Root cause analysis complete, intervention strategy developed

stages.name: Intervention Strategy
stages.objective: Develop targeted retention strategy for each at-risk customer
stages.input: Root cause analysis, customer context, product capabilities
stages.output: Retention strategy with specific actions
stages.activities: Identify intervention approach (product, process, pricing, relationship), assign ownership, define success criteria, plan timeline, identify escalation path
stages.successMetric: Retention strategy documented for each at-risk customer
stages.decisionPoints: Strategy addresses root cause? Ownership clear? Timeline realistic? Success criteria measurable?
stages.qualityGate: Retention strategies approved, owner assignments confirmed

stages.name: Executive Engagement
stages.objective: Secure executive attention for critical retention accounts
stages.input: At-risk accounts, revenue impact, retention strategy
stages.output: Executive sponsor assigned, intervention plan approved
stages.activities: Brief executive on customer situation, secure commitment to intervention, align on approach, establish communication cadence, plan executive outreach
stages.successMetric: Executive sponsor assigned to 100% of high-revenue at-risk accounts
stages.decisionPoints: Executive committed? Approach aligned? Frequency appropriate?
stages.qualityGate: Executive engagement secured, communication plan active

stages.name: Customer Retention Negotiation
stages.objective: Negotiate retention and resolve customer concerns
stages.input: Retention strategy, customer needs, product/pricing options
stages.output: Negotiated agreement to retain customer
stages.activities: Schedule retention conversation, present solutions/options, negotiate terms, document agreement, confirm next steps
stages.successMetric: Agreement reached with 70%+ of at-risk customers
stages.decisionPoints: Customer willing to stay? Terms acceptable? Concerns addressed? Follow-up clear?
stages.qualityGate: Retention agreement signed, implementation plan active

stages.name: Success Plan Refresh
stages.objective: Refresh customer success plan based on retention negotiation
stages.input: Retention agreement, customer commitments, new initiatives
stages.output: Updated success plan addressing retention concerns
stages.activities: Update success metrics based on issues, add new initiatives to address concerns, adjust timeline if needed, reset engagement cadence, communicate changes
stages.successMetric: Updated success plan approved by customer
stages.decisionPoints: New plan credible? Concerns addressed? Resources committed? Customer engaged?
stages.qualityGate: Success plan updated, new engagement calendar active

stages.name: Follow-up & Engagement
stages.objective: Follow through on retention commitments and rebuild relationship
stages.input: Retention agreement, updated success plan
stages.output: Sustained engagement and positive trajectory
stages.activities: Execute on retention commitments, maintain heightened engagement, celebrate early wins, provide regular updates, monitor health improvement
stages.successMetric: Retention commitments delivered, health scores improving
stages.decisionPoints: Commitments delivered on time? Customer satisfaction improving? Churn risk decreasing?
stages.qualityGate: Retention trajectory positive, health improving, relationship stable

stages.name: Customer Maturity Assessment
stages.objective: Assess customer's maturity level and readiness for expansion
stages.input: Customer tenure, usage data, success metrics, organization
stages.output: Maturity assessment with expansion readiness score
stages.activities: Evaluate product adoption, assess value realization, analyze organizational commitment, evaluate technical maturity, assess financial health
stages.successMetric: Maturity score calculated for all customers
stages.decisionPoints: Customer ready for expansion? What's their appetite? Budget available?
stages.qualityGate: Maturity assessment complete, expansion readiness scoring methodology validated

stages.name: Expansion Opportunity Identification
stages.objective: Identify specific expansion opportunities for each customer
stages.input: Customer maturity, product roadmap, use cases, business outcomes
stages.output: List of potential expansion opportunities with ROI estimates
stages.activities: Identify underadopted features for expansion, identify new use cases, identify departments for horizontal expansion, identify add-on products, estimate impact/ROI
stages.successMetric: 2-3 expansion opportunities identified per mature customer
stages.decisionPoints: Opportunities high-value? Aligned to customer needs? Realistic? Customer interested?
stages.qualityGate: Expansion opportunities documented with initial ROI estimates

stages.name: Business Case Development
stages.objective: Develop compelling business case for expansion opportunity
stages.input: Expansion opportunity, customer context, ROI data
stages.output: Business case document with financial and strategic justification
stages.activities: Quantify opportunity impact, identify target department/persona, calculate ROI, identify implementation timeline, document strategic benefits
stages.successMetric: Business case developed for each opportunity
stages.decisionPoints: ROI compelling? Timeline realistic? Impact clear? Customer context reflected?
stages.qualityGate: Business case approved by CSM/sales, ready for customer presentation

stages.name: Customer Alignment
stages.objective: Gain internal alignment on expansion approach
stages.input: Business case, customer context, organizational priorities
stages.output: Aligned expansion strategy with customer stakeholder buy-in
stages.activities: Present opportunity to customer stakeholders, assess interest level, gather feedback, refine approach based on input, confirm willingness to proceed
stages.successMetric: Customer stakeholders engaged, interest confirmed
stages.decisionPoints: Stakeholder interest high? Budget owner interested? Timeline acceptable?
stages.qualityGate: Customer interest confirmed, champion identified, next steps discussed

stages.name: Executive Sponsorship & Proposal Prep
stages.objective: Secure internal executive sponsorship and prepare proposal
stages.input: Customer interest, business case, expansion opportunity
stages.output: Executive-approved proposal ready for customer
stages.activities: Brief sales executive on opportunity, secure sponsorship, prepare formal proposal, coordinate internal resources, brief delivery team
stages.successMetric: Executive sponsor assigned, proposal drafted
stages.decisionPoints: Executive committed? Proposal strong? Resources identified? Timeline confirmed?
stages.qualityGate: Executive approved, proposal ready for presentation

stages.name: Renewal Planning & Qualification
stages.objective: Plan renewal process for all customers approaching expiration
stages.input: Renewal date, customer health, contract terms
stages.output: Renewal plan for all expiring customers
stages.activities: Identify all renewals 6+ months out, assess renewal health, plan renewal strategy by customer, assign renewal owners, identify potential churn risk
stages.successMetric: 100% of renewals planned with owners assigned
stages.decisionPoints: Renewal likely? Strategy clear? Ownership clear?
stages.qualityGate: Renewal plans complete, owners briefed

stages.name: Value & ROI Documentation
stages.objective: Document value delivered and ROI achieved
stages.input: Health metrics, usage data, customer outcomes, contract value
stages.output: ROI and value documentation ready for renewal conversation
stages.activities: Calculate realized ROI, document value delivered, quantify business impact, identify expansion value, prepare executive summary
stages.successMetric: ROI documentation complete for all customers
stages.decisionPoints: ROI credible? Value clear? Documentation compelling?
stages.qualityGate: ROI documentation approved, ready for customer

stages.name: Renewal Negotiation Preparation
stages.objective: Prepare strategy and materials for renewal conversation
stages.input: Renewal plan, value documentation, contract terms
stages.output: Renewal strategy with conversation plan and pricing options
stages.activities: Develop renewal strategy (auto-renewal vs. negotiation), prepare pricing scenarios, identify expansion opportunities, prepare negotiation position, brief internal team
stages.successMetric: Renewal strategy and materials prepared
stages.decisionPoints: Strategy strong? Pricing options clear? Expansion opportunities identified?
stages.qualityGate: Renewal strategy approved, team briefed

stages.name: Renewal Conversation & Value Review
stages.objective: Conduct renewal conversation and review value delivered
stages.input: Renewal strategy, value documentation, customer
stages.output: Renewal discussion documented with customer interest
stages.activities: Schedule renewal meeting, present value and ROI, review year highlights, discuss expansion opportunities, address concerns
stages.successMetric: Renewal conversation conducted, customer interest assessed
stages.decisionPoints: Customer enthusiastic? Churn risk? Expansion interest? Next steps clear?
stages.qualityGate: Conversation documented, customer interest confirmed

stages.name: Negotiation & Terms Refinement
stages.objective: Negotiate renewal terms and finalize agreement
stages.input: Renewal conversation, customer interests, pricing models
stages.output: Agreed renewal terms and pricing
stages.activities: Present renewal proposal with pricing, negotiate terms, address objections, finalize pricing/term, prepare contract
stages.successMetric: Renewal terms agreed and documented
stages.decisionPoints: Terms acceptable? Pricing competitive? Customer committed? Expansion included?
stages.qualityGate: Renewal terms finalized, contract ready for signature

stages.name: Contract Closure & Signature
stages.objective: Execute renewal contract
stages.input: Agreed renewal terms, contract template
stages.output: Signed renewal contract
stages.activities: Prepare final contract, send to customer for signature, execute e-signature process, finalize contract, update CRM and billing
stages.successMetric: Contract signed, billing updated
stages.decisionPoints: Contract clear? Customer ready? Billing aligned?
stages.qualityGate: Contract signed, renewal locked, billing activated

stages.name: Celebration & Next Phase Planning
stages.objective: Celebrate renewal and plan next phase of engagement
stages.input: Signed contract, renewed relationship
stages.output: Celebration communication and next phase plan
stages.activities: Thank customer, celebrate renewal, share success internally, plan next year initiatives, schedule kickoff for new phase
stages.successMetric: Renewal celebrated, next year plan initiated
stages.decisionPoints: Celebration resonant? Next year strategy clear?
stages.qualityGate: Renewal celebrated, next year engagement underway

stages.name: Health Metrics Selection
stages.objective: Identify metrics that predict customer health and renewal
stages.input: Historical data, customer feedback, usage patterns
stages.output: Selected health metrics with definitions
stages.activities: Analyze historical churn patterns, identify leading indicators, define health dimensions (adoption, engagement, support, sentiment), establish metric definitions
stages.successMetric: 5-10 health metrics selected and defined
stages.decisionPoints: Metrics predictive? Data available? Actionable?
stages.qualityGate: Metrics approved, data sources identified

stages.name: Data Architecture & Integration
stages.objective: Build data infrastructure to calculate health scores
stages.input: Selected metrics, data sources, technical requirements
stages.output: Data pipeline delivering health score inputs
stages.activities: Map data sources (product, CRM, support, billing), design data architecture, build data connections, establish data quality checks, plan refresh frequency
stages.successMetric: Data architecture built, pipelines active
stages.decisionPoints: Data accurate? Latency acceptable? Quality consistent?
stages.qualityGate: Data flowing reliably, quality verified

stages.name: Scoring Model Development
stages.objective: Build health scoring algorithm
stages.input: Selected metrics, historical data, model requirements
stages.output: Health score model with weighting
stages.activities: Define scoring methodology, weight metrics by impact, calibrate thresholds, build scoring algorithm, test on historical data
stages.successMetric: Scoring model developed and tested
stages.decisionPoints: Model predicts well? Weights appropriate? Thresholds meaningful?
stages.qualityGate: Model performs well on test data (>70% accuracy)

stages.name: Validation & Testing
stages.objective: Validate model accuracy and applicability
stages.input: Scoring model, historical churn data, validation set
stages.output: Validated model with performance metrics
stages.activities: Test model against historical churn, assess false positive/negative rates, validate with CSM team, refine thresholds based on feedback
stages.successMetric: Model validated with <10% false positive rate
stages.decisionPoints: Model accurate? CSM confident? Thresholds realistic?
stages.qualityGate: Model approved for deployment

stages.name: Score Deployment & Dashboard
stages.objective: Deploy health scores and create monitoring dashboard
stages.input: Validated model, dashboard requirements
stages.output: Live health scores for all customers in dashboard
stages.activities: Deploy scoring model to production, create health dashboards, set up auto-refresh, configure alerts, train team on interpretation
stages.successMetric: Health scores live for 100% of customers
stages.decisionPoints: Scores accurate? Dashboard clear? Alerts appropriate?
stages.qualityGate: Scores live, dashboard adopted by team

stages.name: Monitoring & Alert Configuration
stages.objective: Set up real-time monitoring and alerts for at-risk customers
stages.input: Health scores, alert thresholds, escalation process
stages.output: Active monitoring and alert system
stages.activities: Define alert thresholds (red/yellow/green), configure automated alerts, establish escalation process, test alerts, train team on response
stages.successMetric: Alert system active, team responding to alerts
stages.decisionPoints: Alert frequency appropriate? Response process working?
stages.qualityGate: Alerts sent and acted upon consistently

stages.name: Continuous Model Improvement
stages.objective: Continuously improve model based on performance
stages.input: Score accuracy, churn data, feedback
stages.output: Updated model with improved accuracy
stages.activities: Quarterly review of model performance, analyze misses, identify new signals, update model, retrain team
stages.successMetric: Model accuracy improving each quarter
stages.decisionPoints: New signals identified? Thresholds optimized? Predictability increasing?
stages.qualityGate: Continuous improvement cycle established

stages.name: NPS Program Strategy & Design
stages.objective: Design NPS program and measurement approach
stages.input: Business objectives, customer feedback needs, competitive benchmarks
stages.output: NPS program strategy with measurement plan
stages.activities: Define program objectives, design survey cadence (quarterly/annual), identify target respondents, design segmentation approach, establish benchmark targets
stages.successMetric: NPS program strategy documented
stages.decisionPoints: Cadence appropriate? Segments meaningful? Targets realistic?
stages.qualityGate: Program strategy approved, benchmark established

stages.name: Survey Development & Testing
stages.objective: Create NPS survey and supporting questions
stages.input: Program strategy, customer context, benchmark surveys
stages.output: Finalized NPS survey ready for deployment
stages.activities: Design core NPS question and scale, create follow-up questions (segmentation, satisfaction, recommendation), add open feedback questions, test with sample customers, refine wording
stages.successMetric: Survey tested and refined
stages.decisionPoints: Questions clear? Segmentation helpful? Response rate expected high?
stages.qualityGate: Survey approved, ready for launch

stages.name: Survey Deployment & Collection
stages.objective: Distribute survey and collect responses
stages.input: Finalized survey, customer list, distribution method
stages.output: NPS responses from target customers
stages.activities: Deploy survey via email/in-app/platform, track response rates, send reminders, extend deadline if needed, document response data
stages.successMetric: 30%+ response rate, 100+ responses collected
stages.decisionPoints: Response rate adequate? Sample representative? Data quality good?
stages.qualityGate: Sufficient responses collected for analysis

stages.name: Response Analysis & Segmentation
stages.objective: Analyze NPS responses and segment by customer groups
stages.input: NPS responses, customer data
stages.output: NPS analysis with segments and insights
stages.activities: Calculate overall NPS and by segment, analyze promoter/detractor/passive split, identify trends, segment by company size/industry/tenure, identify correlation with usage/health
stages.successMetric: NPS calculated and segmented, insights identified
stages.decisionPoints: Insights actionable? Segments clear? Trends significant?
stages.qualityGate: Analysis complete, key findings documented

stages.name: Detractor Follow-Up & Voice of Customer
stages.objective: Understand feedback from detractors and low satisfaction customers
stages.input: NPS feedback, detractor list, open-ended responses
stages.output: Detractor insights and recommended actions
stages.activities: Review open-ended feedback, categorize feedback themes, interview sample detractors, identify systemic issues, develop improvement plan
stages.successMetric: Detractor feedback analyzed, themes identified
stages.decisionPoints: Issues fixable? Patterns clear? Product vs. service issue?
stages.qualityGate: Detractor themes documented, action plan created

stages.name: Action Planning & Internal Communication
stages.objective: Develop actions to improve satisfaction and NPS
stages.input: Analysis findings, detractor feedback, resource availability
stages.output: Action plan to address gaps
stages.activities: Prioritize top issues, assign ownership, develop action plan, communicate results to team, celebrate improvements, set targets for next survey
stages.successMetric: Action plan created with owners assigned
stages.decisionPoints: Actions address root causes? Timelines realistic? Resources available?
stages.qualityGate: Actions assigned and tracked

stages.name: Results Communication & Celebration
stages.objective: Communicate NPS results and improvements to team
stages.input: NPS analysis, action plan, improvements made
stages.output: Team communication and celebration
stages.activities: Share NPS results with full team, communicate improvements made since last survey, celebrate improvements, recognize top performers, share customer quotes
stages.successMetric: Results communicated, team engaged
stages.decisionPoints: Communication clear? Team motivated? Ownership clear?
stages.qualityGate: NPS program visible to team, continuous improvement culture evident

stages.name: Success Metrics Framework
stages.objective: Define comprehensive metrics for customer success health
stages.input: Business objectives, CSM responsibilities, customer health indicators
stages.output: Success metrics framework with KPIs
stages.activities: Define health metrics (adoption, usage, satisfaction), define pipeline metrics (renewals, expansion), define operational metrics (cost, efficiency), establish targets
stages.successMetric: Comprehensive metrics framework with 15-20 KPIs
stages.decisionPoints: Metrics comprehensive? Aligned to business? Actionable?
stages.qualityGate: Metrics approved by leadership

stages.name: Data Architecture & Integration
stages.objective: Build data infrastructure for success metrics
stages.input: Metrics framework, data sources, technical requirements
stages.output: Data pipelines feeding success dashboard
stages.activities: Identify data sources (product, CRM, billing, surveys), design data model, build data connectors, establish data quality, test data accuracy
stages.successMetric: Data architecture complete, pipelines active
stages.decisionPoints: Data accurate? Refresh frequency adequate? Latency acceptable?
stages.qualityGate: Data flowing reliably, quality verified

stages.name: Dashboard Design & Visualization
stages.objective: Design intuitive dashboard for success metrics
stages.input: Metrics framework, audience needs, design requirements
stages.output: Dashboard design mockups ready for implementation
stages.activities: Design dashboard layout for different users (CSM, leadership, executive), select visualizations for each metric, define drill-down capabilities, design mobile view
stages.successMetric: Dashboard designs created and reviewed
stages.decisionPoints: Design intuitive? Drill-downs helpful? Mobile ready?
stages.qualityGate: Designs approved, ready for build

stages.name: Dashboard Implementation
stages.objective: Build and deploy success dashboard
stages.input: Dashboard designs, data pipelines, platform
stages.output: Live dashboard with real-time metrics
stages.activities: Build dashboard in platform, configure metrics and visualizations, set up auto-refresh, configure alerts, test all features
stages.successMetric: Dashboard live with all metrics displaying correctly
stages.decisionPoints: Performance adequate? Data accurate? User experience smooth?
stages.qualityGate: Dashboard tested and approved for release

stages.name: Team Training & Adoption
stages.objective: Train team on dashboard usage and interpretation
stages.input: Live dashboard, training materials
stages.output: Trained team using dashboard
stages.activities: Create dashboard user guide, train CSMs on how to use, train leadership on insights, establish dashboard review cadence, create help resources
stages.successMetric: 100% of team trained, usage visible
stages.decisionPoints: Training clear? Team confident? Usage adoption high?
stages.qualityGate: Team trained and actively using dashboard

stages.name: Usage Monitoring & Support
stages.objective: Monitor dashboard usage and provide support
stages.input: Dashboard usage data, team feedback
stages.output: Active dashboard adoption with support
stages.activities: Track dashboard login and usage, provide support for questions, monitor for feedback, identify common issues, provide refresher training
stages.successMetric: 80%+ of team using dashboard regularly
stages.decisionPoints: Adoption growing? Support questions declining? Usefulness evident?
stages.qualityGate: Dashboard becoming integral to CSM workflow

stages.name: Continuous Improvement & Optimization
stages.objective: Optimize dashboard based on usage and feedback
stages.input: Dashboard usage data, team feedback, new metrics needed
stages.output: Improved dashboard with optimizations
stages.activities: Quarterly review of usage, gather feedback on improvements, add new metrics as needed, optimize visualizations, remove unused metrics
stages.successMetric: Dashboard evolving based on feedback
stages.decisionPoints: New metrics valuable? Optimizations improving usage?
stages.qualityGate: Continuous improvement process established
